cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thanks for the lift. I'll cover your Saturday shift. Send a proper handover, please, not a list of first names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No need. I covered yours yesterday so you could rest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll take your whole weekend. Exact start and finish times; I don't leave people half-covered.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already swapped Sunday so I can drive you to the airport.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll cancel the flight and cover your entire holiday. Send every date, please. A weekend is clearly too small a unit for this arrangement.

reason: Make A exacting coverage practice expand with each revealed favour, using B airport sacrifice to motivate A flight cancellation and larger holiday offer.
